rationale: Verified reviewed commit f3488f95cd90526f03334a0734fe1effc8c383d2 in the specified bead worktree. The round-4 diff is prose-only: two ADR Markdown files and comments in internal/complete/complete.go; no executable statement, test, interface, fixture, or generated artifact changed. Spot-checking the load-bearing step-2.25 ordering comment confirms that the stale CommitAll description was replaced with the delivered artifact-materialization/runMaterialization mechanism while preserving the correct reason the panel gate must precede materialization: tip advancement would stale the reviewed SHA and clearing user dirt would invalidate the gate observation. The disclosed additional ADR-0041 reconcile sentence is also a documentation correction consistent with the adjacent statement that reconcile authors no commits. This does not disturb the implementation approved in rounds 2 and 3, so my standing verdict remains APPROVE.

findings.title: Retired-mechanism sweep is confined to accurate prose updates

The step-2.25 comment now names the artifact-materialization subphase/runMaterialization and retains the panel-before-materialization stale-SHA and user-dirt reasoning.
